title: Organiser/admin sales KPIs overstate revenue (refunded tickets at list price, comps as revenue, promos ignored, window on event.created_at)
expected: Aggregates match money actually collected (PAID orders, promo-net) with refunds/net/check-in visible
actual: live: organiser gross_kobo=150000 for 100000 collected; admin gmv=250000 for 200000; refunded ticket counted at full price
root_cause: Aggregates derived from tiers.sold*price_kobo instead of event_orders

title: No organiser order/refund drill-down, date-range filters, or sales/tax statement exports
expected: Organiser can list own orders/refunds, filter by date/event, export a sales-and-tax statement reconciling to the ledger
actual: GET /:id/orders, /:id/refunds, /:id/statement all 404; no from/to params; no statement/PDF export
root_cause: Read surface never built beyond attendees roster + per-event stats

title: No organiser payout/settlement rail — ticket-sale escrow is never disbursed to organisers
expected: Eligible verified organiser balances settle to a beneficiary once, with processor status updates, retry-without-double-pay, reserves, statements, per-merchant segregation, bank-change controls
actual: No organiser payout object/endpoint/job exists at all; only vendor_float→vendor settle exists; escrow holds ticket proceeds indefinitely
root_cause: Payout rail was never scoped into the module — design gap

title: Admin review surface incomplete: no reject/request-changes, no suspend reason, no reactivate, no taxonomy config, no versioned fee config, no manual adjustment
expected: Admin can reject with reason, suspend with reason+audit, reactivate, manage categories and versioned fees, post audited manual adjustments
actual: Only approve/suspend exist; suspend takes no reason; SUSPENDED is terminal (no unsuspend); fee_bps set at creation only

title: Admin dashboard empty surfaces: no audit timeline, gmv trend, ticket mix, settlement-break detection, fraud/anomaly queue, impersonation, maker-checker
expected: Activity feed, timeline, break/fraud queues, impersonation controls and two-person approval for high-risk actions
actual: timeline=[], activity=[], ticket_mix=[], gmv_trend=[], settlement_breaks_open=0, fraud_open=0 — all hardcoded neutral; no impersonation or dual-control paths
root_cause: Data sources and routes never built (honest zeros, not fabricated)

title: Dispute resolve claims 'refunded' but moves no money for non-food module types
expected: resolution=refunded reconciles verified funds (refund post or ticket issue) once
actual: live: admin resolve on module_type=events dispute → 200 {resolved:true}, status 'resolved'/refunded, refund_kobo ignored, no ledger posting
root_cause: Only module_type=='food' dispatches to a real resolver; every other type is a bare status UPDATE

title: Dispute 'reference' accepts any free-text id — foreign order ownership not validated
expected: A complaint can only reference an order the caller owns
actual: live: buyer opened dispute citing organiser's order id → 201 created; order linkage and PII exposure unchecked
root_cause: Open() inserts reference verbatim with no existence/ownership check

title: No support-case model for events: no messages/timeline, attachments, SLA, reopen, or booking-linkage validation
expected: Full helpdesk lifecycle: linked booking, ordered timeline, sanitized attachments with ownership checks, SLA measurements, policy-driven reopen
actual: Generic disputes table only (status flip); no messages/attachments/evidence/SLA; module_type free-text

title: No rate limiting on events purchase/scan/discovery endpoints
expected: Bursts on register/checkout/QR-verify are throttled with minimal impact on valid users
actual: live: 12 rapid POST /purchase → all 400 (tier gate), never 429; events group carries no PerUserRateLimit
root_cause: PerUserRateLimit applied to transfers/pin/referral only; not wired to /events

title: GET /my/tickets and getTicket 500 on tickets with NULL credential_id
expected: Ticket list/detail render regardless of credential presence
actual: live: GET /my/tickets → 500 'cannot scan NULL into *string' (col: credential_id) for any owner with a NULL-credential ticket
root_cause: Queries selected raw credential_id into *string while sibling ticketByOrder COALESCEs it

title: XSS payloads stored unescaped in event title/description
expected: User-supplied HTML stored sanitized or clearly delimited
actual: POST create stored '' title and '' description verbatim; safety depends entirely on client output-escaping (RN Text/React escape by default)
root_cause: No server-side sanitization; API returns raw markup

title: Attendee CSV generated synchronously in-request; no background job or expiring download token
expected: Large guest lists export via background job with protected, expiring download
actual: Whole roster serialized per request; no job/token model — cross-event safety relies on per-request authZ only

title: Suspend is reasonless and irreversible; organiser-level suspension is entirely platform-side
expected: Suspension captures reason/actor and can be reversed after checks
actual: Suspend has no reason param; no unsuspend route; SUSPENDED terminal

title: Denied/failed attempts are not audited (success-only s.log calls)
expected: Audits include denied attempts with actor/subject/result
actual: Only success paths call s.log; forbidden/validation failures produce no audit row; reads never logged
root_cause: Audit emission on success branches only
